description: Query Toxic Release Inventory annual chemical release data for a specific facility. Returns per-chemical release records with chemical name, total release quantity, and reporting year. TRI data lags ~18 months — the most recent available year is typically 2 years prior to the current calendar year. Obtain facility_id (TRI facility ID) from epa_search_facilities. Use epa_search_tri_releases to identify top emitters across a region.

chemical_name.description: Optional filter to restrict results to a specific chemical (partial match, case-insensitive)

facility_id.description: TRI facility ID (from the RegistryID field returned by epa_search_facilities)

year.description: Reporting year to retrieve. Defaults to all available years. TRI data is typically available through ~2 years prior to the current year.

name: epa_get_tri_releases

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_releases_found`: No TRI records found for the given facility ID and filters. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.
Recovery hint when no releases are found — suggests alternative years or checking the facility ID. Absent when releases are returned.

releases.description: Per-chemical annual TRI release records for the queried facility

items.description: Per-chemical TRI release record for this facility and year

chemicalName.description: Chemical name as reported to TRI

releasesToAirInLbs.description: On-site routine air releases (fugitive + stack emissions) in pounds, summed across air release types for this submission.

releasesToLandInLbs.description: On-site routine land releases in pounds — landfills, land treatment, surface impoundment, and other on-site disposal, summed for this submission.

releasesToUndergroundInjectionInLbs.description: On-site routine releases via underground injection wells in pounds, summed across injection well classes for this submission.

releasesToWaterInLbs.description: On-site routine releases to surface water in pounds, summed across all reported outfalls for this submission.

totalReleasesInLbs.description: TRI one-time / non-routine release quantity in pounds (spills, accidents) — a distinct TRI category, NOT the sum of the per-medium routine releases below.

title: Get TRI Chemical Releases for Facility
